name: Phá Kén - Khúc Điêu Linh
source:
Accompany Yen, blooming from the cocoon she calls home and looking out at the outside world and its countless layers. But life waits for no one and the end is near. What choices will Yen and her companion have to make to keep their newly revealed selves, along with all the things that are important to them?

[translated from [url=https://lion-yrish-game.itch.io/pha-ken]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
陪伴甄子丹，从她称之为家的茧中绽放，眺望外面的世界及其无数的层次。但生命不等人，终点已近。甄和她的同伴必须做出什么选择才能保持新的自我以及对他们来说重要的所有事情？

[译自[url=https://lion-yrish-game.itch.io/pha-ken]itch.io[/url]]
